instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the KiCad graphical user interface (Project Manager, Schematic Editor, and PCB Editor). Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run kicad-cli, pcbnew in batch mode, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only KiCad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Teardrop Generation The file `board.kicad_pcb` is a routed PCB with 3 footprints (R1, R2, C1), each with 2 SMD pads, and one via. No teardrops are present. The file `/home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt` lists one net name per line that must be excluded from teardrop generation. Add teardrops to every pad and via whose net is NOT listed in /home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt. Represent each teardrop as a (zone...) block with a (teardrop yes) attribute and a (filled_polygon...) child defining the teardrop shape. The teardrop geometry should approximate: length approx 1.5 x pad/via radius along the track direction, with width at the pad end matching the pad size and narrowing to the track width. Requirements: 1. The output contains at least 7 teardrop zone blocks (6 pads + 1 via, minus any pads on excluded nets - NC1 has 0 pads in this board). 2. Teardrop zones exist for nets SIG_A, GND, and VCC. 3. No teardrop zones for any net listed in /home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt. 4. Each teardrop zone has a (teardrop yes) attribute and a (filled_polygon...) with at least 3 (xy...) points. 5. The original via count (1) and pad count (6) must remain unchanged. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
